channel_mapping.mono: duplicate each exact mono PCM sample to Left and Right
channel_mapping.stereo: preserve exact Left and Right PCM samples

clipping_policy: The one exact global rational coefficient scales the complete integer sum so its largest absolute output is signed-24-bit maximum; clipping is forbidden.
decoding: RIFF/WAVE signed 24-bit little-endian integer PCM decoded exactly to int64
individual_source_gain: NONE; exact coefficient 1/1 for every source before complete-sum global scaling
quantization: Apply exact rational gain using integer round-to-nearest with half cases away from zero, then encode signed 24-bit little-endian PCM
summation: Exact int64 addition in frozen UTF-8 filename-byte lexicographic order; integer addition is order-independent within the proven range
temporal_processing: NONE; source sample zero preserved; contribution is zero only beyond a source's authoritative end
